relations.evidence: Pressure Reactivity Index (PRx) is the moving correlation between mean arterial blood pressure (MAP) and Mean intracranial pressure (ICP). It is calculated as a moving Pearson correlation coefficient between changes in 30 consecutive ten second-averages of the ratio between Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP) and Mean intracranial pressure (ICP). It has values between - 1 and 1, with higher values reflecting an indirect measure of more impaired cerebral autoregulation.
